title: Moves Before Cancellation and the Fee Offset in In-Person Appointments Deposit Refunds
content:
**Q. On a late-cancelled In-Person Appointments visit, does a patient's earlier move of the visit change the late-cancellation fee the refund offsets?**

Yes:

- where the patient moved the visit and the latest move was made **30 days or fewer** before the cancellation date, **10.00** dollars are added to the late-cancellation fee the refund offsets;
- where the patient moved the visit and the latest move was made **more than 30 days** before the cancellation date, **5.00** dollars are added;
- where the patient never moved the visit, nothing is added.

**Q. How does the desk tell whether the patient moved the visit?**

From the appointment record: a reschedule count of one or more patient-requested reschedules, and the date of the latest reschedule. Moves made by the clinic and waitlist moves do not raise the count.

**Q. From which date is the age of the latest move measured?**

To the cancellation date, in days.

**Q. Where is the line?** (hypothetical dates)

| Latest move | Cancelled | Days | Added |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-09-15 | 2026-10-15 | 30 | 10.00 dollars |
| 2026-09-14 | 2026-10-15 | 31 | 5.00 dollars |
| no move | 2026-10-15 | not applicable | nothing |
